(3) The owner lease repeatedly bounced to the env-default session id because reviewer/implementer subagents inherit LATTICE_SESSION_ID from env, not the pinned lattice-stale; needed --forceTakeover (same-worktree, no live conflicting session) twice. Lesson: in pinned-session runs, expect to forceTakeover after subagent waves.
